title: macOS
summary: A macOS test machine needs every privacy pair the bridge drives: Automation from /usr/libexec/sshd-keygen-wrapper to System Events, Terminal and Safari; Automation from Terminal to System Events; Accessibility for the helper and Terminal; Screen Recording for Terminal. Older macOS opens System Preferences instead of a consent dialog, so the Terminal to System Events row is ticked by hand. bridge-diagnose and every Terminal case start run a short probe inside Terminal and refuse terminal_system_events_automation_missing (automation_missing:Terminal->System Events) on -1743 or a timeout, before any window waits on consent. Terminal windows are force-closed by killing their tty processes, so cleanup never leaves a terminate-processes sheet.
